findings.evidence: `#if UINTPTR_MAX == 0xffffffff` wraps every K2GuiInputApi layout check (`static_assert(sizeof(K2GuiInputApi) == 24, ...)` and the five `offsetof(K2GuiInputApi, ...)` checks at lines 9-15). On any 64-bit host build the whole block is compiled out, so the ABI layout of K2GuiInputApi is not asserted at all by this test; only the K2WheelEvent asserts (lines 18-26) run unconditionally.
findings.suggested_investigation: Check how run_tests builds cpp tests (target arch / -m32 flag) and whether any build of gi_registry_test.cpp runs with UINTPTR_MAX == 0xffffffff. If not, consider whether the layout block should be exercised in a 32-bit build or should fail loudly when skipped. Verify by compiling gi_registry_test.cpp on a 64-bit host and confirming the K2GuiInputApi asserts are absent from the translation unit.
findings.why_it_matters: The mod ships as 32-bit, but if the test harness builds or runs on a 64-bit host (the default on most Linux/Windows CI) the struct-layout gate for the provider table silently passes with zero checks. A future field reorder in GuiInput.h would not be caught there.
